name: Adaptive Surface
summary: Adaptive Surface 1.0.1 for Hytale 0.7.4 replaces the 1.0.0 material-learning release after reproduced request-loss and false saved/reopen failures. Isolated native tests pass for immediate durable discovery, first restart, RocksDb scanning and learned-material placement. The user reported that the delivered 1.0.1 now works; no per-material client log was supplied. Eight historical appearances still need surviving input, and real historical-world migrated client entry remains unverified. No mod browser publication has been performed by Codex.
constraints: All Rights Reserved for original Zytale work; do not distribute native or third-party pixels without documented rights.
Preserve 804 saved state definitions and formerly approved geometry/material appearance.
Do not claim universal old-save recovery or real migrated-client entry from synthetic/server tests.
Source projects and publication files are separate; test harnesses, worlds and learned caches stay private.
decisions: Public JAR contains original code/geometry/icon and recipes; material pixels are generated locally from installed assets and optional verified historical input.
Automatic and Normal ramp are separate /surface modes, four rotations each; prior rc.19 behavior was user accepted.
Use a copied world, verified backup and rollback for historical migration; exact old save client entry remains a release boundary.
Final visual check and bounded release decision are the author's responsibility; do not publish test evidence as gameplay screenshots.
